Want to fix your plank in seconds and improve your overall core strength and posture? This video reveals a simple trick to help you engage your core muscles and maintain a perfect plank position. Say goodbye to back pain and hello to a stronger, leaner you! Learn how to fix your plank form and take your workouts to the next level.
